1.text: Zaburi iyi ni iya Asafu.Imana y'imbaraga nyinshi, Imana Rurema, Uwiteka iravuze,Ihamagaye isi uhereye aho izuba rirasira,Ukageza aho rirengera.

2.text: Kuri Siyoni aho ubwiza butagira inenge,Ni ho Imana irabagiraniye.

3.text: Imana yacu izaza ye guceceka,Imbere yayo umuriro uzakongora,Umuyaga w'ishuheri uzayigota.

4.text: Izahamagara ijuru ryo hejuru,N'isi na yo kugira ngo icire ubwoko bwayo urubanza.

5.text: Iti “Munteranirizeho abakunzi banjye,Basezeranishije nanjye isezerano ibitambo.”

6.text: Ijuru rizavuga gukiranuka kwayo,Kuko Imana ubwayo ari yo mucamanza.Sela.

7.text: “Bwoko bwanjye nimwumve nanjye ndavuga,Wa bwoko bw'Abisirayeli we, ndaguhamiriza,Ni jye Mana, Imana yawe.

8.text: Sinkugayira ibitambo byawe,Ibitambo byawe byokeje biri imbere yanjye iteka.

9.text: Sinzakura impfizi mu rugo rwawe,Cyangwa isekurume mu biraro by'ihene zawe.

10.text: Kuko inyamaswa zose zo mu ishyamba ari izanjye,N'inka z'ibirarashyamba zo ku misozi igihumbi.

11.text: Nzi inyoni n'ibisiga byose byo ku misozi,Inyamaswa zo mu ishyamba ni izanjye.

12.text: “Iyaba ngira inzara sinakubwira,Kuko isi n'ibiyuzuye ari ibyanjye.

13.text: Mbese aho narya inyama z'amapfizi,Cyangwa se nanywa amaraso y'ihene?

14.text: Utambire Imana ishimwe,Uhigure Isumbabyose umuhigo wawe.

15.text: Kandi unyambaze ku munsi w'amakuba no ku w'ibyago,Nzagukiza nawe uzanshimisha.”

16.text: Ariko umunyabyaha Imana iramubaza iti“Wiruhiriza iki kuvuga amategeko yanjye,Ugashyira isezerano ryanjye mu kanwa kawe,

18.text: Uko ubonye umujura wishimira kubana na we,Kandi ufatana n'abasambanyi.

19.text: “Ushyira ibibi mu kanwa kawe,Ururimi rwawe rukarema uburiganya.

20.text: Wicara uvuga nabi mwene so,Ubeshyera mwene nyoko.

21.text: Ibyo urabikora nkakwihorera,Ukibwira yuko mpwanye nawe rwose.Ariko nzaguhana mbishyire imbere y'amaso yawe,Uko bikurikirana.

22.text: “Nuko mwa bibagirwa Imana mwe,Mutekereze ibi kugira ngo ne kubashishimura,Hakabura ubakiza.

23.text: Untambira ishimwe wese aba anyubahiriza,Kandi utunganya ingeso ze,Nzamwereka agakiza k'Imana.”
